source_evidence: For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
problem: The lane declares authority="authority" (automated system, agent owner) but the warehouse is a department of the wholesaler performing picking, packing and booking, which the rubric maps to sovereignty.
correction: Change Lane_warehouse's aef:laneMeta to authority="sovereignty" (human owner); keep pick-parts, pack-order, book-carrier, quality-inspection and labelling in it.

source_evidence: The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.
problem: The map wires pick-parts --quality-inspection--> quality-inspection --quality-inspection--pack-order--> pack-order, declaring quality inspection happens after picking and before packing, exactly the order the source says nobody knows; only labelling is honestly left unconnected and annotated.
correction: Delete the flows pick-parts--quality-inspection and quality-inspection--pack-order, restore the direct flow pick-parts--pack-order (the source states "picks the parts, packs the order"), and leave quality-inspection unconnected in Lane_warehouse annotated like labelling (order relative to packing, picking and labelling not recorded), keeping the W-XML-DISCONNECTED/W-XML-UNREACHABLE/W-XML-DEADEND findings as the honest end state.

problem: The task "Send payment reminder" (with flows generate-and-send-invoice--send-payment-reminder and send-payment-reminder--accepted-order-fulfilled, and its flowNodeRef in Lane_erp) has no basis in the source, and its documentation quote "The ERP sends a payment reminder after seven days." is fabricated — that sentence appears nowhere in SOURCE.md.
correction: Delete the task send-payment-reminder, its two sequence flows and its flowNodeRef in Lane_erp, and route generate-and-send-invoice to the existing end event accepted-order-fulfilled with a plain converging flow as delivery already does (or leave it without successor and keep W-XML-DEADEND).
